description: This file contains functions and variables for rendering Markdown content into HTML, including handling of inline elements, block elements, and escaping URLs.

methods.name: RenderHTML
methods.description: Converts Markdown string to HTML using block rendering.

methods.name: RenderBlockHTML
methods.description: Renders a block element and its children into HTML.

methods.name: renderBlockHTML
methods.description: Internal recursive function to render different block types into HTML.

methods.name: escapeURL
methods.description: Escapes special characters in URLs for safe HTML embedding.

methods.name: RenderInlineHTML
methods.description: Renders inline Markdown elements into HTML.
